text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break, I went to see <chrname> 
and found her talking to an unusual group 
of people.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>. I was just hearing all sorts 
of stories from <chrname>-san.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
France... The "Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe"... So many things I don't 
know... I'm so excited.

It seems they asked <chrname> to share her 
experiences from Project L'Arc with them.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, Trainer <username>, I'd love to 
hear your story for future reference!
choice_data_list:
Talk about what happened in the streets of 
Paris
Talk about what happened at the racetrack

text_block_list.text:
Living up to its name as the City of Art, 
every sight I saw in Paris with <chrname> was truly 
breathtaking.

I shared the memory of how seeing that 
between training sessions had been 
nourishment for both my soul and <chrname>'s.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful memories... How nice... Someday, 
I hope I can make some too... with 
Trainer... Mun.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer <username>. You're going to take on the 
challenge again this year, right? The Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Both Meek and I are cheering you on from 
the bottom of our hearts. As the ultimate 
goal we strive toward...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the 
pinnacle of world racing, and its 
spectator stands carry the air of high 
society, where world-class ladies and 
gentlemen gather—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shared the memory of feeling a different 
kind of tension on my skin compared to 
Japanese racetracks, which really helped 
sharpen my focus.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
The world... world-class... my heart's 
pounding... Someday, I want to... with 
Trainer... *mun*.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer <username>. You're going to take on the 
challenge again this year, right? The Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Both Meek and I are cheering you on from 
the bottom of our hearts. As the ultimate 
goal we strive toward...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What surprised me in the land of 
gastronomy wasn't just the restaurants, 
but how delicious even the "everyday 
ingredients" bought at ordinary 
supermarkets were.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going grocery shopping with <chrname> at a 
well-stocked supermarket had naturally 
become one of the daily highlights.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
That's nice... Looks fun... Picking out... 
with the Trainer... French... baguettes in 
France...
